name: org-workspace
description: A light global guide for an org folder of many repos: /org-init maps who calls whom and writes a short managed block into the root CLAUDE.md saying where the truth of each thing lives; /org-learn updates it from a conversation.

name: pre-push-review
description: Fires an expert panel of code reviewers before every git push and blocks the push on critical findings. Portable, versioned — no per-machine hand-wiring.

name: quality-kernel
description: A quality-assurance kernel for agentic development: a seven-agent SwarmForge-style engine (specifier -> designer -> coder -> cleaner -> architect -> hardener -> QA) with deterministic quality tools, a blind live-oracle verifier, epistemic-discipline gates, and a deterministic quality gate (/gate).

name: spa-kit
description: A factory for client SPAs that classic search crawlers and AI answer engines can both read. Generates a standalone Next.js site from a declarative brief, derives the whole OKLCH palette from one brand hex with enforced contrast targets, and verifies it with three independent oracles: a no-JavaScript crawler probe, a blind breaker, and a Playwright suite (visual, a11y, motion contract, web vitals). Includes the /spa-kit interview skill.
